Multimodal bioprinting of pigmented skin with algorithm-tuned control.

High AI for Bioprinting pubmed Direct Read now in_vitro Exp. validation
Rihui Kang, Meng Li, Rong Cheng, Luxiao Sang, Anguo Liu et al. Biomaterials advances 2026-01-01 10.1016/j.bioadv.2025.214487
单位: Key Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence & Micro Nano Sensors, Shanxi Province, College of Integrated Circuits, Taiyuan University of Technology, Taiyuan, China; Shanxi Research Institute of 6D Artif
通讯: Shengbo Sang @ Key Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence & Micro Nano Sensors, Shanxi Province, College of Integrated Circuits, Taiyuan
相关性: 该论文将AI优化控制算法（PSO-FOPI）集成到生物打印工作流中，直接相关于AI辅助生物打印的研究方向。
边界: The paper does not advance to autonomous decision-making; the AI is used only for control optimization, not for adaptive process planning or real-time feedback.
动机· 解决功能性色素皮肤模型生物打印中的可靠性和营养输送难题。
方法· 结合挤出与微阀沉积的多模态打印，并用PSO优化分数阶PID控制。
结果· 成功构建色素均匀分布、生物性能优良的皮肤模型，培养基消耗降至10%。
验证· 通过组织学表征和功能实验验证打印皮肤模型的色素分布和生物性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the challenges of fabricating functional pigmented skin models with high reliability and efficient nutrient delivery.
Method· A hybrid bioprinting strategy combining extrusion and microvalve deposition was developed, with a particle swarm optimization-tuned fractional-order proportional-integral controller for precise motion control.
Result· The engineered skin model exhibited uniform pigment distribution and excellent biological performance, while reducing culture medium consumption to 10% of conventional requirements.
Validation· Histological characterization and functional assays confirmed uniform pigment distribution and biological performance of the printed skin model.

Yanfeng Zhao, Yaozhen Hou, Zhiqiang Zheng, Xinyi Dong, Qing Shi et al. IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics 2026-01-01 10.1109/tmech.2026.3656633
单位: Intelligent Robotics Institute, School of Mechatronical Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing, China
通讯: Yanfeng Zhao @ Intelligent Robotics Institute, School of Mechatronical Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing, China
相关性: 该论文将深度学习与时间离散生物打印结合，实现了单细胞封装和刚度梯度微凝胶的制造，直接契合AI辅助生物打印的研究方向。
边界: This paper does not advance to autonomous decision-making; the AI is used for cell localization but not for closed-loop control or adaptive printing.
动机· 实现单细胞在可组合刚度梯度微凝胶中的封装，以研究细胞在微尺度界面的响应。
方法· 集成增强深度学习模型与时间离散生物打印，通过数字微镜器件生成动态掩模控制打印。
结果· 成功封装MDA-MB-231细胞，刚度梯度超过2 kPa时细胞向软区域延伸。
验证· 通过体外细胞实验验证了微凝胶刚度梯度对细胞行为的影响。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To encapsulate single cells in microgels with composable stiffness gradients for investigating cellular responses at microscale interfaces.
Method· An enhanced deep learning model for single-cell localization was integrated with time-discrete bioprinting using a digital micromirror device to generate dynamic masks for real-time control.
Result· MDA-MB-231 cells were encapsulated in GelMA microgels with tunable stiffness (1.42–11.42 kPa), and cells extended toward softer regions when stiffness gradient exceeded 2 kPa.
Validation· In vitro experiments with MDA-MB-231 cells validated the effect of stiffness gradients on cell behavior.

动机· 开发能促进骨整合的骨支架，减少应力遮挡。

Motivation· To enhance both primary mechanical stability and long-term osseointegration of orthopaedic implants through optimized porous titanium architectures.
Method· A multidisciplinary approach combining RNA sequencing, mechanical insertion/expulsion tests, and 28-day in vitro perfusion cultures with bone cells.
Result· 3D porous titanium promoted osteogenic signaling and ECM remodeling while attenuating inflammation; angled surface struts improved fixation strength; interconnected porous channels sustained internal fluid flow.
Validation· In vitro cell culture assays and mechanical testing (insertion force, expulsion force, rotational stability) were used.

Motivation· To investigate the synergistic effects of etching and electropolishing on the surface morphology and mechanical properties of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds for biomedical applications.

Motivation· Current tumor spheroid models fail to replicate the hierarchical and heterogeneous tumor microenvironment, necessitating a more accurate in vitro construction method.
Method· A multifunctional bioprinting strategy integrates electric field modulation for droplet transport and dielectrophoresis for cell aggregation, followed by DMD-controlled photopolymerization to encapsulate spheroids in ECM-mimicking hydrogels.

Motivation· To develop an integrated in vitro model of the human heart-kidney axis for studying inter-organ communication in cardiorenal syndrome.
Method· Co-cultured hiPSC-derived cardiac microtissues and kidney organoids in a microfluidic organ-on-chip platform, with a bioprinting strategy for scalable kidney organoid fabrication.
Result· Nephrotoxic stress in kidney organoids induced molecular and functional impairment in cardiac microtissues, recapitulating CRS type 3 mechanisms.
Validation· Structural and functional integrity of tissues was validated under static and perfused conditions using microscopy and functional assays.

Motivation· Conventional microalgae cultivation suffers from suboptimal light distribution and mass transfer, necessitating engineered geometries.
Method· A closed-loop computation-guided framework integrating predictive modeling, 3D bioprinting, and quantitative experimentation was employed to design perforated slab and V-groove structures.
Result· Perforated slab and V-groove geometries exhibited higher algal growth rates compared to flat slabs under the same volume and footprint.
Validation· Experimental photosynthetic parameters were integrated into radiative transfer and oxygen diffusion-reaction simulations to validate observed trends.

Result· A low defect rate of 0.49% was achieved, and compressive strength increased by 30% after heat treatment due to phase transformation and solid solution strengthening.
Validation· Microstructural characterization via XRD and SEM, and compressive mechanical testing.

Motivation· To develop an effective preventive strategy against peri-implantitis, a common complication causing progressive bone loss around dental implants.

Result· Ag-Est816 treatment significantly preserved peri-implant bone volume (BV/TV 23.6% vs. 5.1% in controls) and promoted new bone regeneration with trabecular integrity.
Validation· Micro-CT and histological analysis confirmed bone preservation and tissue integrity in the animal model.

Motivation· To evaluate the biomechanical fixation effects of different tibial tray backside designs in uncemented posterior-stabilized total knee arthroplasty.
Method· Finite element models were developed to compare von Mises stress and interface micromotion under walking and squatting loads for three tibial tray designs: cylindrical stem with triple flat keel, tapered stem with double flat keel, and cylindrical stem with double serrated keel.
Result· The cylindrical stem with double serrated keel design exhibited the highest proximal tibial stress (124.03 MPa) and the lowest maximum micromotion (361.91 µm) during squatting, yielding the largest area suitable for bone ingrowth (42.53%).
Validation· The study is a simulation-based comparison without experimental validation.

Motivation· To evaluate the influence of implant length and bone density on primary stability of dental implants.
Method· Implants of varying lengths were placed into polyurethane foam blocks of different densities, and primary stability was measured via insertion torque and resonance frequency analysis.
Result· Implant length significantly affects primary stability, but its effect is highly dependent on bone density.
Validation· In vitro experiments using polyurethane foam blocks as bone surrogates.

Motivation· To report technical strategies for total hip arthroplasty in a rare case of chronic pubic diastasis with post-traumatic arthritis.
Method· A modified posterolateral approach with functional pelvic normalization and landmark-based acetabular orientation was used to implant a press-fit cup and short uncemented stem.
Result· Harris Hip Score improved from 74 to 93 at 12 weeks, and radiographs up to 2 years showed stable osseointegration.
Validation· Single-case clinical follow-up without biomechanical validation.

相关性: 该论文是关于牙种植体手术技术的综述，与髋关节植入物和股骨柄的应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析无关。
边界: This paper is a dental implant surgery review with no biomechanical modeling, no femoral stem or hip implant analysis, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no FEA or contact mechanics.
动机· 比较压电手术与传统骨切开术对牙种植体稳定性和骨吸收的影响。
方法· 对9篇系统综述进行伞状综述，使用AMSTAR 2评估质量。
结果· 两种技术在种植体存活率和骨吸收方面无显著差异，压电手术改善二次稳定性但手术时间更长。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate whether piezosurgery offers clinical advantages over conventional sequential osteotomy for dental implant site preparation.
Method· An umbrella review of nine systematic reviews was conducted following PRISMA guidelines, with methodological quality assessed using AMSTAR 2 and Glenny checklists.
Result· Implant survival and marginal bone loss were comparable between techniques; piezosurgery improved secondary stability and postoperative comfort but required longer operative time.
Validation· No experimental validation; the study is a secondary analysis of existing systematic reviews.
